subject: Quarter launch — owner endorsements & ops cues
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc:
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter launch — owner endorsements & ops cues

Team —

Attached is the owner matrix + a draft SLA we will surface for the Acme Analytics launch thread next week. These are the minimal asks from leadership to commit owners and highlight any operational gating items. High level:

- Owners matrix: who drives metric, who owns rollout tasks, escalation contact.
- SLA draft: baseline latency & availability asks that Acme expects and our fallback policy.

Please do three things by EOD Thursday:
1) Mark your owners (rows in Q2_owners_matrix). I'm expecting concrete names, not team names.
2) Flag any ops blockers (infra quotas, certs, or regional restrictions) under the "Blockers" column.
3) Add any contract risk to the SLA doc comments (I left a few questions for legal).

I'm circulating this to execs on Friday morning; we need a short readout (2 bullets) from each owner to include in the QBR packet. If you can't make those asks, reply here with what you will commit and when.

Attachments: [Q2_owners_matrix.xlsx (12KB)] [SLA_proposal_acme_v2.pdf (48KB)]

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
VP, Platform & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
——

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter launch — owner endorsements & ops cues

Jordan —

Thanks for pulling this together. A few quick notes after skimming:
- Owners matrix: I'll own the onboarding playbook row but will assign Claire (cc'd on my side note in the sheet) as the technical owner for templates.
- Blockers: We need a staging VPC in us-west-2 for Acme's compliance scan; infra can stand this up but needs a PO and resource tag. Adding that to the sheet.
- SLA: Latency targets look fine; suggest adding an optional burst clause to cover sales demos (30s per 95th pct for demo load).

I'll add comments to both attachments and update the owner names. Planning a short sync with infra tomorrow to confirm the staging timeline.

Laura Bennett
Head of Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter launch — owner endorsements & ops cues

Jordan/Laura —

I've updated the owners matrix with infra contacts and ETA for staging VPC (target: 2027-04-06). Two notes:
- Certificate rotation for customer routing needs the security team's sign-off (I've pinged Mina). If we don't get that by 04/05, we'll need to reduce the scheduled ramp for the first week.
- We're short one GPU node in us-west-2 for the scheduled demo window; infra recommends temporary burst on Dedicated for the first 48 hours.

I'll add these as blockers. If leadership is comfortable approving the burst, infra can schedule the capacity change.

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

> Karthik/Team — please add the infra details and blockers. We need clear ask for execs.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics <s.roberts@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarter launch — owner endorsements & ops cues

Jordan — all set from my side.

- Owners: I've populated the launch comms and CS onboarding owner rows; Tara will be the day-zero contact for escalation.
- Blockers: Noting the staging VPC & certificate dependency; I've proposed an interim rollback plan if cert sign-off slips (details in the sheet).
- SLA: Acme confirmed they are fine with a demo burst clause so long as it is limited and billed separately. They asked for a short weekly sync once we pass UAT.

Marissa (cc'ing Acme for visibility)
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
